from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judicial document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the judicial document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document (e.g., 行政再审审查裁定书，刑事判决书，国家赔偿委员会决定书)")
    proceeding_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal proceeding (e.g., Administrative Litigation, Criminal Trial, State Compensation)")
    dispute_focus: str | None = Field(description="Core subject of the legal dispute (e.g., 强制拆除，行政许可，司法行政管理，错误执行，渎职罪，集资诈骗)")
    involved_authority: list[str] | None = Field(description="List of government agencies or parties involved in the dispute")
    key_legal_terms: list[str] | None = Field(description="List of key legal terms or charges mentioned (e.g., 违法强拆，滥用职权，不予行政许可)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
